title: Beyond the Model: A Survey of Harness Software for Embodied Agents
content: Embodied foundation models produce impressive demonstrations, but executing long, complex tasks depends on software outside the model, just as in the ransition from ChatGPT to Codex. We call that software the embodied agent harness and divide it into planning, skill acquisition, memory, monitoring, and self-evolution. The papers come from robotics, machine learning, and embodied-AI venues, 2022--2026. About a fifth of the citations are preprints or non-archival manuscripts, mostly for new directions. Open problems remain in efficiency, robustness, generalizability, model availability, multi-robot orchestration, and evaluation.
